products.name: BB Re-entry EA (BTCUSD)
products.summary: Bollinger Bands re-entry robot for BTCUSD on M1 with an ADX 20–30 filter, signal-candle stop and an on-chart control panel. Test listing: not yet independently validated.
products.broker_conditions: MT5 broker offering BTCUSD; tested by the developer on Exness-style pricing
products.description: Trades when a candle closes back inside the Bollinger Bands (SMA 20, 2 deviations) after closing outside them, only when the direction changes and ADX is between 20 and 30. Entry is a stop order at the signal candle's high/low; the initial stop is $100 from entry and then tightens to each new signal candle's low/high; an opposite breakout closes and reverses.
features: Auto lot from risk % or manual lot
Own magic number (runs next to other EAs)
products.risk: This is a test listing. The EA has not passed our full validation process yet and no verified results are published. The default risk setting is high (10% of balance per trade) — lower it to 1% or less. BTCUSD on M1 is very volatile; slippage and spread can make results much worse than any replay.
how_to_use: Install in MetaTrader 5: File → Open Data Folder → MQL5 → Experts.
Attach to a BTCUSD M1 chart and enable Algo Trading.
Set the risk to 1% or less (input 'RiskPercent') before running.
Run on a demo account first; never use money you cannot afford to lose.
